question: Question linked to the image nº10 Indicate in which type of De Bakey classification the pathology shown in the image could be included:

options.opd: In order to classify it, the area of ​​reentry distal to the light of the aorta must be appreciated, which is not visualized in the image.

analysis: The De Bakey classification categorizes aortic dissections based on their location and extent. Type I involves dissections that originate in the ascending aorta and extend to the descending aorta. Type II is confined to the ascending aorta, while Type III is limited to the descending aorta. Without the image, it is difficult to determine the exact classification, but if the area of reentry distal to the aorta is not visible, it may suggest that a definitive classification cannot be made.
